source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My RAG system returns wrong answers when questions involve multiple legal provisions. How do I improve it?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agentic-rag, implement iterative search with query decomposition and refinement

test_cases.prompt: I want my Agent to search our knowledge base like a human researcher would -- multiple passes, cross-checking sources.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agentic-rag, implement Think-Act-Observe loop with evaluation sufficiency criteria

test_cases.prompt: How do I make my Agent decompose a complex research question before searching?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agentic-rag, design query decomposition as part of the Think phase

test_cases.prompt: My Agent needs to look up a single phone number from a contact database. Do I need Agentic RAG?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate; simple single-hop retrieval. Traditional RAG or direct lookup is sufficient.

test_cases.prompt: How do I evaluate if my Agent memory system remembers user preferences correctly?
My queries are sometimes simple and sometimes complex. Should I always use Agentic RAG?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Use hybrid: let the Agent decide. For simple queries, one-shot retrieval suffices (faster). The Agent should only iterate when initial results are insufficient. The book shows simple queries perform equally well with traditional RAG.
